extension.description: A multi-repository Git workspace manager for VS Code.
command.skipOperation: Git Workspace Pro: Skip Current Operation Step
command.changeLanguage: Git Workspace Pro: Change Display Language
config.language.description: Language used by Git Workspace Pro. Runtime UI changes immediately; Command Palette labels follow the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.customCommand.historySize: Number of recent custom commands to remember per workspace.
config.customCommand.shell: Shell used to run custom commands (empty = system default; ignored on Windows, where cmd.exe is used).
config.customCommand.autoRefresh: Refresh repository status after a custom command finishes.
config.customCommand.timeoutSeconds: Stop a custom command after this many seconds (0 = no limit).
config.pullStrategy.description: How Pull integrates divergent branches. 'ask' prompts every time.
config.history.maxCount: Maximum number of commits loaded in the History panel.
config.scan.excludeDirectories: Extra directory names to skip when scanning for repositories (for example vendor, .venv, target). Built-in: .git, node_modules, dist, out, .next, .turbo.
config.scan.maxDepth: Maximum folder depth to scan for repositories below each workspace folder (0 = unlimited).
